_meta.source_document: LIMEN Helix — Comprehensive Neurology & Nervous System Reference (Jul 2026). THIS DOCUMENT ONLY. Domain-generic sections copied verbatim from finance-neuro-substrate.json (itself verbatim from energy-neuro-substrate.json).
_meta.additive_contract: Purely additive overlay. Does NOT modify assets/data/domains/science.json or any existing science file. References existing Science node IDs and issue IDs by value only. Mirrors the Finance/Energy neuro-substrate overlay shape for the Science domain.
_meta.advisory_only: This overlay is ADVISORY. It classifies existing authored circuits against the source document's Part XIV failure taxonomy and runs the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. It writes nothing back and changes no live behavior on load.

heterogeneity_flagged: DATA_FRAUD — UNMAPPED. Its named mechanism (canonical OFC[Hyper] 'outcome valuation / update — confabulation' + summary 'fabricated or falsified data') is an INFORMATION-INTEGRITY / deception failure. None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-dynamics archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation) expresses a fabricated-signal / adversarial-deception failure. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING AND IT REPLICATES FINANCE: Science, like Finance (FRAUD_SCANDAL), carries a fraud/confabulation archetype on the SAME OFC node that the neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent — a failure family Energy did not contain.

Its CANONICAL node cue is NAcc[Hypo] 'incentive/reward drive — avolition', a drive-loss flavor with no exact analog among the 9 classes; this node-cue vs summary divergence is recorded, not resolved by guessing.

The canonical dACC[Hyper] 'priors-too-strong' cue also carries a predictive-coding (top-down priors dominate) flavor, which is a MECHANISM (XIII.5) whose failure is not one of the 9 Part XIV classes. The canonical NEURODEGENERATION definition also names protein AGGREGATION, which has no Science analog; only the diffuse-attrition + network-collapse aspect grounds the map. Recorded.

_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Science-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Science issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in science_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes, it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

REPLICATION_CRISIS.science_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hypo]: "conflict/error monitor — noise-chase"; _authored dACC[Hypo-active]: "Peer review fails to catch the methodological weaknesses and statistical errors that produce irreproducible results, indicating error-detection breakdown"; summary: "the primary self-correction mechanism" failing to reproduce findings
REPLICATION_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is a HYPOACTIVE error/quality monitor: the peer-review error-detection gate is down, so methodologically unreliable results pass unfiltered into the record. Too-little filtering that floods the system with junk is the GATING_FAILURE archetype ('too little filtering -> flooding').
REPLICATION_CRISIS.note: Distinct subtype from PUBLICATION_BIAS (which is a WRONG-CRITERION gate). Here the gate is simply too permissive (down), not mis-configured.

FUNDING_COLLAPSE.subtype: resource/input loss -> distant connected regions disabled across the graph
FUNDING_COLLAPSE.science_text: summary: "Severe reduction in government and institutional research funding... causing laboratory closures, talent exodus, and abandonment of long-term research programs"; _authored vmPFC[Hypo] funding contracts -> M1[Hypo] "Laboratory operations scale down or shut entirely", DMN[Hypo] "Hypothesis generation narrows", TPJ[Hypo] "Social science research disproportionately loses funding"; canonical circuit NAcc[Hypo]: "incentive/reward drive — avolition"
FUNDING_COLLAPSE.reasoning: One input (funding/resource supply) is withdrawn and the loss propagates to distant, otherwise-intact regions (labs, hypothesis generation, social-science communities). That is the DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS definition: the network, not the node, is the unit of failure; failures propagate across the graph.
FUNDING_COLLAPSE.note: The canonical NODE cue is NAcc[Hypo] 'avolition' (a reward/drive-loss flavor) with no exact analog among the 9 classes; classed on the summary + authored cascade rather than on the node cue. Divergence flagged, not resolved by guessing.

DATA_FRAUD.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
DATA_FRAUD.science_text: canonical circuit OFC[Hyper]: "outcome valuation / update — confabulation"; summary: "Discovery of fabricated or falsified data in high-profile publications... triggering institutional investigations and retraction cascades"
DATA_FRAUD.reasoning: 'Confabulation' and 'fabricated or falsified data' describe an INFORMATION-INTEGRITY / adversarial-deception failure: deliberately corrupted signals. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses fabricated-content or deception. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
DATA_FRAUD.note: KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING, AND IT REPLICATES FINANCE EXACTLY: Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL is UNMAPPED on the very same OFC[Hyper] 'confabulation' cue. Two independent domains place the deception/fraud archetype on the SAME node and BOTH fall outside the E/I-dynamics taxonomy — strong evidence the taxonomy has a structural blind spot for information-integrity failure, and that this blind spot is domain-general, not a Finance quirk. Energy contained no such issue.

PARADIGM_CONFLICT.science_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; summary: "dividing the research community and paralyzing progress as competing camps interpret evidence through incompatible conceptual lenses"; _authored AG[Altered]: "Citation patterns fragment into isolated clusters as each paradigm camp preferentially cites its own literature and ignores the other's contributions"
PARADIGM_CONFLICT.reasoning: The dominant mechanism is the field splitting into camps that no longer communicate — citation networks fragment into isolated clusters. Groups that are incoherent/under-coupled are functionally disconnected: the OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY archetype (under-coupling degrades communication).
PARADIGM_CONFLICT.note: The dACC[Hyper] 'priors-too-strong' cue also carries a predictive-coding flavor (top-down priors overriding bottom-up error). Predictive coding is a MECHANISM (XIII.5); its failure is not itself one of the 9 Part XIV classes, so the class is anchored on the fragmentation/communication-breakdown cue, and the priors-too-strong straddle is recorded.

BRAIN_DRAIN.subtype: progressive unit loss (human capital) + institutional-memory clearance failure -> cumulative network collapse
BRAIN_DRAIN.science_text: canonical circuit dlPFC[Hypo]: "executive-lapse, distractible"; summary: "Exodus of trained scientists... depleting the human capital required for sustained scientific progress"; _authored HIPP[Hypo]: "Institutional memory and tacit methodological knowledge are lost as senior researchers retire or emigrate without adequate knowledge transfer"; M1[Hypo]: "Laboratory capability degrades as skilled technicians and principal investigators depart"
BRAIN_DRAIN.reasoning: The units of the network (researchers) are progressively lost, stored knowledge (institutional/tacit memory) degrades, and network capacity collapses cumulatively over time. That diffuse-attrition-plus-compounding-collapse pattern is the NEURODEGENERATION archetype (maintenance failure compounding over time; network collapse).
BRAIN_DRAIN.note: The canonical NEURODEGENERATION definition also names protein AGGREGATION, which has no Science analog; only the unit-loss + memory-clearance-failure + compounding-collapse aspects ground this map. Recorded, not force-fit.

PUBLICATION_BIAS.subtype: mis-configured gate -> wrong information passed (selective filtering on results, not methods)
PUBLICATION_BIAS.science_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; _authored BROCA[Altered]: "Publication and dissemination systems filter out null and negative results, creating a scientific record that systematically overrepresents positive findings"; _authored dACC[Altered]: "Peer review... a quality filter that selects on results rather than methods"
PUBLICATION_BIAS.reasoning: The publication/peer-review gate is not down but MIS-CONFIGURED: it passes positive results and blocks null results, filtering on the wrong criterion. Mis-timed/mis-configured gating that lets the WRONG information through is the GATING_FAILURE archetype ('mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed').
PUBLICATION_BIAS.note: Same class as REPLICATION_CRISIS but a different subtype: REPLICATION_CRISIS = too-permissive gate (flooding); PUBLICATION_BIAS = wrong-criterion gate (selective distortion). Finance similarly carried two GATING_FAILUREs (BANKING_CRISIS, CREDIT_FREEZE).

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against science.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list, falls back to circuits).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (6/6). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory driver without its brake. Same headline result as Finance (6/6) and Energy (6/6). NOTE: ONE issue (FUNDING_COLLAPSE) has a CANONICAL single-node circuit (NAcc) that is a bare non-regulatory node and WOULD fail the test in isolation; its _authored multi-node circuit supplies the regulatory partner. (Finance had two such issues; Science has one.)

REPLICATION_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is dACC[Hypo] (dACC IS in REGULATORY_NODES) -> passes even canonical-only.

FUNDING_COLLAPSE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is NAcc[Hypo] alone (a reward-drive node, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies vmPFC/dlPFC brakes. This is the only Science issue with a bare non-regulatory canonical node.

DATA_FRAUD.observation: Circuit is complete (dACC oversight + HIPP memory-index present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (fraud/confabulation) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent (identical situation to Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL).

BRAIN_DRAIN.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is dlPFC[Hypo] (dlPFC IS in REGULATORY_NODES) -> passes even canonical-only.

parameter_table._note: Part XV, verbatim. Quantitative substrate for scale-rescaling. Confidence + anchor preserved.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Science mapping must preserve an analogous separation between fast experimental action (a single assay/measurement) and slow governance (funding cycles, peer review, replication, citation accrual), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
